name: OFAC Sanctions List Service (SDN list exports)
operator: Office of Foreign Assets Control (OFAC), U.S. Department of the Treasury
tier_rationale: U.S. government body (A8 trusted: government bodies). 'Providers (dataset downloads, no value sent): OFAC/US Treasury, UN Security Council and the European Commission, all trusted tier.' (P219 cond 2). The S3 bucket host is OFAC's own publication storage: the export URLs answer 302 to pre-signed URLs on it (verified 2026-11-26).

reliability.justification: The authoritative Specially Designated Nationals list published by the designating agency; a local copy is as current as its last daily download (no value is ever sent).

error_markers.reason: OFAC SLS: the pre-signed S3 download link expired (valid about 1 h): request the export again (v3lum data update sanctions)
OFAC SLS: the S3 storage refused the published export (error document instead of the list): the previous copy is kept

sdn.title: OFAC SDN list exports (SDN.CSV, SDN_COMMENTS.CSV, ALT.CSV, ADD.CSV; datasets matched locally)

terms.quote: Sources: OFAC SDN CSV from the Sanctions List Service (US government work, public domain), UN consolidated XML (UN public information) and EU FSF CSV (EU open data, reuse with attribution; the Commission's public token is a config value).

sdn.notes: Quote: binding council text (P219 cond 1); research C0511 terms 'US Government public data' / 'US Government work - public domain'. Datasets sanctions_ofac_sdn (SDN.CSV, 5.86 MB, no header, 12 columns, '-0-' = null, 0x1A trailer), sanctions_ofac_sdn_comments (remarks spill-over beyond 1000 characters, appended without separator), sanctions_ofac_alt (aliases) and sanctions_ofac_add (addresses), all through the dataset manager (TTL 24 h, `v3lum data update sanctions`), never downloaded during a scan (P219 cond 3, A6 BR9). GET https://sanctionslistservice.ofac.treas.gov/api/PublicationPreview/exports/<FILE> answers 302 to a pre-signed URL on wc2h-sls-prod-public-published.s3.us-gov-west-1.amazonaws.com (X-Amz-* credential parameters, about 1 h): both hosts belong here. Used by sanctions_lists (batch p1-G10-1).

notes: Owned by batch p1-G10-1 (P219 sanctions_lists). Dataset downloads only: no investigated value is ever sent (disclosure 'none' module). The S3 redirect URL carries temporary X-Amz-Credential / X-Amz-Security-Token / X-Amz-Signature parameters: never cache, log or store it unredacted (core request: redact.KEY_PARAMS does not cover X-Amz-*). The SDN.CSV file carries no publication date: the list date shown is the download date unless the core exposes Last-Modified.
